title: Acute haemoglobin decline and the ST segment: analysis code
description: Analysis code, study protocols and aggregate results for a two-centre, within-patient electrocardiographic study of acute haemoglobin decline and the ST segment (HEEDB / MGH discovery; MIMIC-IV / BIDMC external validation). The protocols were prespecified and internally locked, with dated change logs, but were not registered on a public platform before analysis. Version 1.1.0 adds post hoc analyses that were defined after all protocol results were known, set out in a dated addendum and locked with SHA-256 hashes before they were run (protocols/concept_addendum_posthoc.md). No patient data are included.
